title: 第一卷 第73章 哪个干部经得起这样的考验第一卷 第72章 可救天下人
lines: 在这里，也可以俯视下方波光粼粼的掌心湖。
在那湖泊的中心位置，有着十几艘花船。
那是陈家的船只，灯火在夜幕下摇曳。
陈擎苍看了眼那掌心湖，又遥望远处灯火点点的郡城。
随之，他的目光，又落在两侧的其余山峰上。
陈家族地五指峰，分别为拇指峰、食指峰、中指峰、无名峰、小指峰。
最终，陈擎苍的目光落在拇指锋上，想到陈渊能够将玄品丹药，提升到天品，心中已然澎湃。
下一瞬，他身形如老鹰一般掠向空中，朝着拇指峰飞去。
炼丹殿，便是在那里。
陈渊刚回到自己的居所，本打算着休息，就被陈建初，陈昭宁，以及李伟等十几个陈家子弟拉着下山。
他们说要去庆祝一下，今日干死卢志远的事。
“去哪里庆祝？”
陈渊愣了愣，看着兴致勃勃的一帮人，目光落在全身绑着绷带的陈建明身上，“你都这样了，还去？”
“少主救命之恩，我哪怕是舍了这条命，也要陪少主！”
陈建明咬牙的道。
“哎呀，废什么话？我要带你们好好逛一逛天庆郡城的夜市！”
陈昭宁打断正要说话的陈渊，抱起糯米就走。
她很清楚，糯米都去了，陈渊不可能舍得不跟上。
陈渊无奈，摆了摆手，“我们今日太高调了，现在还下山的话，会被人盯上，不如改变装扮一下，悄悄下山。”
他也想看看天庆郡的夜市，但这样下去，着实是太吸引仇恨。
“改变装扮？”
陈昭宁目光一亮，“你说得对哦，我让千婆婆过来给我们装扮易容一下。”
“千婆婆？”
陈渊疑惑。
“是文商殿的一位老师。”
陈昭宁点头说着，没多久，一名灰发佝偻着身子的老妪，被陈昭宁带了过来。
那老妪对陈渊行礼之后，就开始给众人修改装扮，或是易容。
于是众人开始换发型，贴胡须、戴帽子、换穿衣衫，忙得有条不紊。
片刻后，陈渊贴好胡须，戴着一顶青色帽子，瞧着竟像个温文尔雅的青年书生。
与先前的自己，完全不同了，恐怕一般人都无法看得出来。
陈昭宁亦是如此，她女扮男装，一身白净书生的模样，眉眼间却藏不住几分英气。
糯米戴着小巧的帽子，胖嘟嘟的小脸粉雕玉琢，模样甚是可爱，活像个机灵的小书童。
其余人也都打扮妥当，或扮作护卫，或装成世家纨绔。
就连白天受伤严重的陈建明，都变成一个坐轮椅的中年大叔了。
只不过他说话还是极度虚弱，白天的伤势太严重了，此刻却还是强撑着要凑热闹。
陈渊坳不过他，只好作罢，让陈建初照顾好他之后，一行人悄无声息地下了山。
他们在后山下来，专门避开那些前来求取丹药，
以及秘境位置的修士，朝着天庆郡城的方向疾驰而去。
天庆郡城。
content_en:
Here, you can also overlook the sparkling Palm Lake below.
In the center of the lake, there are more than a dozen flower boats.
It was the Chen family's boat, its lights swaying in the night.
Chen Qingcang glanced at the Palm Lake, and then looked at the county town with lights in the distance.
Then, his eyes fell on the other peaks on both sides.
The five finger peaks of the Chen family are thumb peak, index finger peak, middle finger peak, nameless peak and little finger peak.
Finally, Chen Qingcang's eyes fell on the tip of his thumb, and his heart was already surging when he thought that Chen Yuan could upgrade Xuanpin elixir to Tianpin.
The next moment, he flew into the air like an eagle, flying towards Thumb Peak.
The Alchemy Hall is right there.
——————
As soon as Chen Yuan returned to his residence and planned to take a rest, he was pulled down the mountain by more than a dozen children of the Chen family, including Chen Jianchu, Chen Zhaoning, and Li Wei.
They said they wanted to celebrate and kill Lu Zhiyuan today.
"Where to celebrate?"
Chen Yuan was stunned for a moment, looking at the excited group of people, his eyes fell on Chen Jianming who was all bandaged, "You are like this, why are you still going?"
"Thanks to the young master for saving my life, I will accompany you even if I risk my life!"
Chen Jianming gritted his teeth and said.
"Oh, what nonsense are you talking about? I want to take you to visit the night market in Tianqing County!"
Chen Zhaoning interrupted Chen Yuan who was about to speak, picked up Nuomi and left.
She knew very well that Chen Yuan would not be able to keep up when the glutinous rice was gone.
"...Wait a minute."
Chen Yuan was helpless and waved his hand, "We are too high-profile today. If we go down the mountain now, we will be stared at. Why don't we change our clothes and go down the mountain quietly."
He also wanted to see the night market in Tianqing County, but if it continued like this, it would really attract hatred.
"Change your outfit?"
Chen Zhaoning's eyes lit up, "You're right, I asked Granny Qian to come over and dress us up."
"Grandma Qian?"
Chen Yuan was confused.
"It's a teacher from Wenshang Palace."
Chen Zhaoning nodded and said, and not long after, an old woman with gray hair and a stooped body was brought over by Chen Zhaoning.
After the old woman saluted Chen Yuan, she began to modify everyone's clothes or change their appearance.
So everyone began to change their hairstyles, put on beards, wear hats, and change clothes, and they were busy in an orderly manner.
After a while, Chen Yuan put on his beard and wore a green hat, looking like a gentle and elegant young scholar.
It is completely different from the previous self, and I am afraid that most people cannot see it.
The same is true for Chen Zhaoning. She dresses as a man and looks like a fair scholar, but she can't hide a bit of heroism between her eyebrows.
Nuomi wears a small hat and has a chubby little face. She looks very cute, just like a clever little book boy.
The rest of the people were also dressed up, either as guards or as playboys from aristocratic families.
Even Chen Jianming, who was seriously injured during the day, has turned into a middle-aged uncle in a wheelchair.
But he was still extremely weak when he spoke. His injuries during the day were too serious, but he still managed to join in the fun at this moment.
Chen Yuanyao couldn't defeat him, so he had to give up and let Chen Jianchu take care of him, and then the group descended the mountain quietly.
They came down the back mountain specifically to avoid those who came to ask for elixirs.
As well as the monks in the secret location, they rushed towards Tianqing County City.
……·····
Tianqing County City.
